description: This file contains functions that render 2D ellipse shapes and rings using OpenGL, including filling and stroking ellipses with specified colors and segments.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ring(lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number inner_radius_w,lua_Number inner_radius_h,lua_Number strokeWeight,lu5_color color,lua_Integer segments)
methods.description: Renders an elliptical ring (donut shape) with specified inner radii, stroke weight, and color, subdivided into segments.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipse_fill(lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lu5_color color,lua_Integer segments)
methods.description: Renders a filled ellipse at given coordinates with specified width, height, color, and segments.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipse(lua_Number x,lua_Number y,lua_Number w,lua_Number h,lua_Number strokeWeight,lu5_color fill,lu5_color stroke,lua_Integer segments)
methods.description: Renders an ellipse with optional fill and stroke colors, stroke weight, and segmentation.
